blocks.title: OpenMetadata — explore and govern your data directory from Astravia
blocks.description: Connect to any OpenMetadata instance, browse tables and dashboards, trace lineage across pipelines, and view data quality results. Exposes 14 MCP tools so the AI agent can search metadata, fetch entity details, resolve column-level lineage, diagnose failing test cases, and answer governance questions.

items.title: Keyword & Semantic Search
items.description: Find tables, dashboards, pipelines, glossary terms and metrics by name or natural-language description.

items.title: Column-Level Lineage
items.description: Visualize upstream and downstream DAGs for any entity with React Flow. Double-click to recursively expand.

items.title: Data Quality Overview
items.description: List all test cases, see status badges, open recent run history and drill into failing definitions.

items.title: 14 MCP Tools for the AI Agent
items.description: om_search_metadata, om_semantic_search, om_get_entity_details, om_get_entity_lineage, om_find_context, om_root_cause_analysis, om_create_entity, om_patch_entity...

items.q: Do I need to expose my OM instance directly to the AI agent?
items.a: No. The plugin runs a local host-node proxy process that forwards requests to your OM instance with your JWT. Renderer → proxy (localhost) → OM. No CORS, no public URLs, no network.allowedHosts expansion.
Any OpenMetadata instance exposing the standard /v1 REST API. Tested against recent 1.12–1.16 builds. Semantic search requires vector embeddings to be configured on your OM cluster.
